conditions: Ali confirms plugged in and no heavy work. No local tests/builds overlap collection. Exclusive GPU use is not verified.
source_and_image_boundary: All trials use the committed 24 November freeze; no previous-candidate observations are pooled.

timing_boundaries.fresh_stack_ready: Immediately before Compose up to the first ready response through Nginx; image downloads/builds and first inference excluded.
timing_boundaries.service_start_to_ready: Immediately before docker start to first ready response; excludes the preceding stop and outage probes, not total downtime.
timing_boundaries.p95: Nearest-rank p95 equals maximum at n=3; no tail-latency or population claim.

limitations: Idle outages only, not an in-flight GPU-job crash.
No model accuracy claim; failed detector gate and unsupported dense crowds unchanged.
Exclusive GPU use not verified; background conditions retained per trial.
